newsitem.title: UK: LME elects Kit Farrow as new Vice-Chairman.
newsitem.headline: LME elects Kit Farrow as new Vice-Chairman.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) said on Thursday that Kit Farrow had been elected by the board as its new vice-chairman.
In a release the LME said that Farrow was elected at Wednesday's regular monthly board meeting. Farrow has been an invited director of the LME since 1987.
Farrow replaces former vice-chairman Ralph Kestenbaum who was not re-elected to the board at last month's rotational elections.
Also on Wednesday, the LME approved various committee chairmanships.

These included Vivian Davies for Arbitration and lead, Nigel Dentoom and Tom McGuigan as chairman and vice-chairman respectively of the ring committee, Simon Underhill on traded options, Barry Jones on aluminium alloy, Miles Linington on primary aluminium, and Peter Sellars on zinc.
